Customer Segmentation Summary

Total Customers on Record: 299

Segment Breakdown:
  - Inactive: 126 customers (42.1%) | avg spend ₹3,939.74 | avg 8.7 transactions
  - Loyal: 67 customers (22.4%) | avg spend ₹7,778.88 | avg 13.2 transactions
  - New: 45 customers (15.1%) | avg spend ₹885.52 | avg 1.6 transactions
  - At-Risk: 43 customers (14.4%) | avg spend ₹5,605.37 | avg 10.1 transactions
  - VIP: 18 customers (6.0%) | avg spend ₹18,253.76 | avg 22.0 transactions

Customer segments are computed based on recency, frequency, and spend. VIP customers have the highest lifetime value. At-Risk customers were previously active but have not transacted in 25–45 days. Inactive customers have been absent for more than 45 days. (Synthetic / Illustrative Demo Data)

At-Risk & Inactive Customer Analysis

At-Risk Customers: 43 customers
  - Definition: Previously active, absent for 25–45 days.
  - Average Historical Spend: ₹5,605.37
  - Recovery Opportunity: These customers have demonstrated purchase intent     and may respond to a targeted win-back offer.

Inactive Customers: 126 customers
  - Definition: Absent for more than 45 days.
  - Average Historical Spend: ₹3,939.74
  - Recovery Opportunity: Re-engagement campaigns with cashback or discount     offers may bring a portion back.

Churn Prevention Strategy: Running re-engagement campaigns for the 43 at-risk customers before they become fully inactive is the highest-priority retention opportunity. (Synthetic / Illustrative Demo Data)
